concepts.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
concepts.summary: Coordinate specialist agents through explicit ownership, shared contracts, and bounded execution so a business task produces one accountable result.

concepts.title: Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs)
concepts.summary: Represent bounded agent work as explicit dependencies, enabling reproducible scheduling, parallel branches, and precise restart boundaries.

concepts.title: Agentic State Machines
concepts.summary: Make agent progress an explicit set of states, guarded transitions, and durable events so every action has a permitted execution context.

concepts.title: Hierarchical Orchestration
concepts.summary: Delegate through supervisory layers that preserve domain ownership, limit context, and return evidence-rich results to a single accountable decision maker.

concepts.title: Dynamic Routing
concepts.summary: Select the appropriate agent or workflow from request intent, capability, authorization, and uncertainty while keeping routing decisions observable and reversible.

concepts.title: Asynchronous Agent Execution
concepts.summary: Move long-running agent work into durable jobs with explicit acceptance, progress, cancellation, and completion semantics.

concepts.title: Agent Inter-communication (A2A)
concepts.summary: Interoperate across independently operated agents through explicit capability discovery, task lifecycle contracts, authenticated messages, and verifiable artifacts.

concepts.title: Plan-and-Execute Pattern
concepts.summary: Separate deliberate task planning from controlled execution, validating dependencies and revising only the parts invalidated by new evidence.

concepts.title: ReAct Framework (Reasoning + Acting)
concepts.summary: Alternate bounded action proposals with tool observations, allowing an agent to adapt its next step while application code controls authority and termination.

concepts.title: Reflection Loops
concepts.summary: Use explicit critique and revision cycles to improve a draft against measurable criteria, while avoiding unsupported confidence from repeated self-assessment.

concepts.title: Tool Invocation & Function Calling
concepts.summary: Convert model-proposed operations into validated, authorized tool calls with stable schemas and explicit treatment of side effects.

concepts.title: State Persistence
concepts.summary: Persist the minimum authoritative execution state needed to recover an agent run, maintain concurrency safety, and explain completed work.

concepts.title: Sub-Goal Generation
concepts.summary: Decompose broad objectives into bounded sub-goals with explicit dependencies, measurable completion criteria, and a controlled expansion budget.

concepts.title: Token-Aware Routing
concepts.summary: Route work according to estimated context and output demand while preserving capability, evidence quality, and a hard task-level token budget.

concepts.title: Event-Driven Agent Triggers
concepts.summary: Start bounded agent work from meaningful business events using durable publication, deduplicated consumption, and explicit event-to-task ownership.

concepts.title: Task Interruption & Resumption
concepts.summary: Pause a durable execution at a defined boundary and resume it with validated input, current authority, and reconciled external effects.

concepts.title: Agent Lifespan Management
concepts.summary: Control how agent instances are created, leased, reused, drained, and retired so long-running work does not accumulate abandoned resources or authority.

concepts.title: Semantic Condition Checking
concepts.summary: Evaluate meaning-dependent workflow conditions through evidence-backed classification while keeping hard business predicates deterministic and reviewable.

concepts.title: Context Condensation
concepts.summary: Compress accumulated context into a versioned working summary that preserves commitments, evidence pointers, unresolved questions, and recovery-critical facts.

concepts.title: Deterministic Output Stripping
concepts.summary: Extract and validate an explicit public output contract so model responses cannot leak internal fields, malformed wrappers, or unintended executable content.

concepts.title: Authorization-Aware RAG
concepts.summary: Apply the requester’s current data entitlements throughout retrieval, reranking, generation, caching, and citation delivery.

concepts.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
concepts.summary: Assign stable permissions to organizational roles and enforce those permissions at every agent tool and data boundary.

concepts.title: Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC)
concepts.summary: Evaluate access from trusted subject, resource, action, and environment attributes when static roles cannot express the required business boundary.

concepts.title: Prompt Injection Mitigation
concepts.summary: Constrain untrusted instructions at data boundaries and prevent retrieved content from acquiring tool authority, secrets, or control over the agent workflow.

concepts.title: Data PII Masking
concepts.summary: Detect and transform personal data before model exposure while preserving task utility, protecting reidentification mappings, and measuring missed entities.

concepts.title: VPC Peering / Private Links
concepts.summary: Connect agent workloads to private services through deliberately scoped network paths while retaining application authentication, encryption, and egress control.

concepts.title: Responsible AI Governance (ISO/IEC 42001)
concepts.summary: Translate responsible-AI commitments into an operating management system with named owners, risk decisions, evidence, and continuous improvement.

concepts.title: Deterministic Data Grounding
concepts.summary: Bind generated claims to verified records and use deterministic computation for values that must be exact, current, and reproducible.

concepts.title: Output Jailbreaking Guardrails
concepts.summary: Apply an explicit output policy before publication and prevent unsafe model content from becoming executable instructions or unauthorized business actions.

concepts.title: Non-Repudiation Logs
concepts.summary: Create attributable, tamper-evident records of agent decisions and actions while recognizing that evidence strength depends on identity, keys, and independent custody.

concepts.title: LLM Evaluation Frameworks (TruLens/Ragas)
concepts.summary: Evaluate agent and RAG behavior with versioned datasets, component metrics, calibrated judges, and release criteria tied to actual task outcomes.

concepts.title: Model Bias Auditing
concepts.summary: Measure whether model behavior and downstream decisions differ across relevant groups, investigate causes, and validate mitigations within the actual application context.

concepts.title: Token Rate Limiting
concepts.summary: Enforce token-based admission and consumption budgets so individual requests and tenants cannot exhaust shared inference capacity or spend.

concepts.title: Tenant Isolation
concepts.summary: Prevent one tenant’s identity, data, state, tools, or resource consumption from crossing into another tenant’s execution boundary.

concepts.title: Adversarial Prompt Testing
concepts.summary: Continuously test adversarial inputs against the application’s actual trust boundaries, measuring unauthorized effects and preserving reproducible regression cases.

concepts.title: Watermarking AI Outputs
concepts.summary: Attach or detect provenance signals in generated content while treating watermark evidence as limited, attack-sensitive, and distinct from proof of truth.

concepts.title: Zero-Data Retention (ZDR) Contracts
concepts.summary: Translate retention commitments into enforceable endpoint selection, feature restrictions, logging controls, and evidence that the deployed data path matches the agreement.

concepts.title: Data Lineage Tracking
concepts.summary: Track how source data becomes chunks, embeddings, prompts, model outputs, and decisions so changes and incidents can be traced to their affected artifacts.

concepts.title: Content Moderation API
concepts.summary: Integrate content classification as a versioned policy service with explicit thresholds, contextual handling, latency budgets, and review paths.

concepts.title: Explainable AI (XAI)
concepts.summary: Provide audience-appropriate explanations grounded in actual evidence, rules, and execution records without presenting generated rationales as faithful internal reasoning.

concepts.title: Idempotent Tool Execution
concepts.summary: Make repeated attempts at one business operation converge on one recorded effect, even when agents, queues, or networks deliver the request more than once.

concepts.title: Circuit Breakers (Resilience4j)
concepts.summary: Stop sending ordinary traffic to an unhealthy dependency, probe recovery deliberately, and protect the rest of the agent workflow from repeated failure.

concepts.title: Self-Correction Loops
concepts.summary: Repair specific validated defects in an agent’s work through bounded feedback, preserving accepted facts and preventing repeated unsafe actions.

concepts.title: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)
concepts.summary: Place accountable human decisions at explicit workflow boundaries, presenting sufficient evidence and preserving approval scope through execution.

concepts.title: Graceful Degradation
concepts.summary: Preserve the most valuable safe subset of service during dependency failure, making reduced capability and evidence freshness explicit to users.

concepts.title: Max Iterations Fallback
concepts.summary: Terminate agent loops predictably when iteration, time, cost, or progress limits are reached, returning an honest partial outcome and a controlled next step.

concepts.title: Fallback Prompt Strategies
concepts.summary: Use evaluated alternate prompt strategies for specific recoverable failure classes while preserving policy, evidence requirements, and response contracts.

concepts.title: Dead-Letter Queues (DLQ) for Agents
concepts.summary: Quarantine repeatedly failing agent jobs with enough context for diagnosis and controlled replay, keeping poison work from blocking healthy processing.

concepts.title: Timeout Policies
concepts.summary: Allocate end-to-end deadlines across queueing, inference, tools, retries, and finalization so work stops predictably and uncertain side effects are reconciled.

concepts.title: Exponential Backoff with Jitter
concepts.summary: Retry transient failures with bounded exponential delays and randomized timing, preserving operation identity and respecting the remaining task deadline.

concepts.title: State Rollbacks
concepts.summary: Restore a coherent workflow checkpoint while explicitly compensating business effects that a database rollback cannot undo.

concepts.title: Model Redundancy / Multi-Provider Failover
concepts.summary: Continue eligible model work through independent providers without silently changing capability, privacy, or output contracts.

concepts.title: Health Check Endpoints for Agents
concepts.summary: Separate process survival, traffic readiness, and end-to-end agent capability so health automation makes the correct recovery decision.

concepts.title: Memory Leak Mitigation in Long-Running Agents
concepts.summary: Bound retained state and resource lifetimes so long-running agents remain stable as conversations, tools, and tenants accumulate.

concepts.title: Distributed Tracing (OpenTelemetry)
concepts.summary: Connect agent decisions, retrieval, model calls, and tool effects into one causal execution record using interoperable trace context.

concepts.title: Load Balancing LLM Requests
concepts.summary: Distribute inference work using token demand, queue pressure, capability, and cache locality instead of treating all requests as equal.

concepts.title: Crash-Safe Memory
concepts.summary: Persist agent progress and effect receipts so a replacement worker can resume safely after an abrupt process or machine failure.

concepts.title: Partial Success Management
concepts.summary: Represent completed, failed, and unknown sub-results explicitly so a workflow can deliver useful work without misrepresenting completion.

concepts.title: Cascade Failure Prevention
concepts.summary: Contain overload and dependency failures so one slow tool or model does not consume the capacity of an entire agent platform.

concepts.title: Chaos Engineering for AI
concepts.summary: Test explicit resilience hypotheses by injecting controlled infrastructure and AI-specific faults, then measuring whether workflow invariants survive.

concepts.title: Semantic Caching (Redis/GPTCache)
concepts.summary: Reuse validated answers for sufficiently similar requests while preserving tenant, policy, freshness, and task boundaries.

concepts.title: Hybrid Search (Dense + Sparse)
concepts.summary: Combine lexical precision with semantic recall, then fuse candidate rankings under one authorization and evaluation contract.

concepts.title: Metadata Pre-Filtering
concepts.summary: Restrict the searchable evidence set using trusted metadata before semantic ranking, while validating the store’s actual filtering behavior.

concepts.title: Parent-Child Chunking
concepts.summary: Retrieve precise child passages, then expand them into bounded parent context that preserves meaning, provenance, and access boundaries.

concepts.title: Re-ranking (Cohere/Cross-Encoders)
concepts.summary: Use a stronger query-document relevance model on a bounded shortlist before expensive generation consumes the evidence.

concepts.title: Query Deconstruction / Expansion
concepts.summary: Turn complex or underspecified questions into bounded retrieval plans while preserving the original intent and evidence requirements.

concepts.title: Graph RAG / Knowledge Graphs
concepts.summary: Combine entity relationships with source passages to answer connection-oriented questions that isolated similarity matches cannot resolve.

concepts.title: Time-Weighted Vector Retrieval
concepts.summary: Blend semantic relevance with task-appropriate freshness while distinguishing publication time, event time, and validity.

concepts.title: Vector Database Scaling (Pinecone/Milvus)
concepts.summary: Scale vector retrieval by separating storage, indexing, query capacity, tenancy, and ingestion while measuring recall under real constraints.

concepts.title: Dynamic Prompt Assembly
concepts.summary: Build each model request from versioned policy, authorized evidence, task state, and a deliberate token allocation.

concepts.title: Context Window Optimization
concepts.summary: Allocate finite model context to the evidence and state that matter, preserving constraints and enough capacity for a complete response.

concepts.title: Self-RAG / Self-Reflection
concepts.summary: Use bounded evidence critique to decide when retrieval or revision is necessary, while avoiding self-confidence as a substitute for verification.

concepts.title: Cross-Lingual Retrieval
concepts.summary: Retrieve evidence across languages using evaluated multilingual representations or translation paths while preserving source meaning and access scope.

concepts.title: Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE)
concepts.summary: Generate a hypothetical relevant passage to improve retrieval alignment, then answer only from real retrieved evidence.

concepts.title: Chunk Overlap Tuning
concepts.summary: Tune shared text between neighboring chunks to preserve boundary evidence without filling retrieval results with duplicates.

concepts.title: Multi-Aspect Indexing
concepts.summary: Index different views of the same source so queries can match its content, purpose, entities, and structure without losing source identity.

concepts.title: Real-time Vector Ingestion
concepts.summary: Keep retrieval synchronized with changing source systems using versioned events, idempotent processing, and measurable visibility lag.

concepts.title: Lost in the Middle Mitigation
concepts.summary: Test and reduce position-sensitive evidence loss in long prompts through selection, ordering, local extraction, and explicit coverage checks.

concepts.title: Embedding Model Fine-Tuning
concepts.summary: Adapt the retrieval representation to domain relevance using trustworthy examples, hard negatives, and a controlled re-indexing migration.

concepts.title: Token Pruning
concepts.summary: Remove low-value prompt content under a measured quality constraint while preserving negation, identifiers, evidence, and instructions.

concepts.title: Dynamic Model Routing
concepts.summary: Select an eligible model for each task using measured capability, quality, latency, and cost while keeping policy constraints mandatory.

concepts.title: Small Language Models (SLMs) Deployment
concepts.summary: Deploy compact models for bounded tasks where local control, latency, or operating cost matters and measured capability is sufficient.

concepts.title: Speculative Decoding
concepts.summary: Use a cheap proposal mechanism and target-model verification to reduce decoding latency only where acceptance and workload conditions justify the overhead.

concepts.title: Model Quantization (AWQ/GGUF)
concepts.summary: Reduce model representation cost using hardware-compatible quantization while validating task quality, memory headroom, and actual serving speed.

concepts.title: LLM Cold Start Optimization
concepts.summary: Shorten the path from a scheduled inference replica to usable capacity by measuring and optimizing each initialization stage.

concepts.title: Streaming LLM Responses
concepts.summary: Deliver incremental model output with explicit completion, cancellation, validation, and reconnect semantics rather than treating chunks as a finished answer.

concepts.title: Batch Prompting
concepts.summary: Amortize work across independent items while preserving item identity, isolation, validation, and retry boundaries.

concepts.title: vLLM / TensorRT-LLM Engines
concepts.summary: Treat the inference engine as a scheduled memory-and-compute system whose configuration must match models, hardware, and service objectives.

concepts.title: Serverless LLM Architecture
concepts.summary: Separate request admission from elastic inference capacity so serverless execution can scale safely despite model startup and duration constraints.

concepts.title: LoRA / QLoRA Fine-Tuning
concepts.summary: Adapt a base model through low-rank trainable updates, optionally over a quantized frozen base, with explicit compatibility and evaluation controls.

concepts.title: GPU Cluster Orchestration (Kubernetes/KServe)
concepts.summary: Coordinate accelerator placement, model readiness, autoscaling, and recovery as one serving system rather than treating GPUs as ordinary interchangeable CPU slots.

concepts.title: Pre-Computing Embeddings
concepts.summary: Compute reusable document vectors ahead of requests using content identity, version lineage, and an explicit freshness strategy.

concepts.title: Model Versioning and A/B Testing
concepts.summary: Version the complete inference behavior and compare releases through stable assignment, meaningful outcome measures, and reversible promotion.

concepts.title: Token Cost Allocation Tracking
concepts.summary: Attribute inference usage to the business work that caused it, including retries, caches, tools, and shared infrastructure.

concepts.title: Distributed Memory Architectures
concepts.summary: Distribute model weights, activations, and attention state across devices with an explicit communication and failure model.

concepts.title: Semantic Similarity Analytics
concepts.summary: Analyze semantic neighborhoods to find retrieval gaps, repeated intents, and content drift without treating vector distance as an objective truth score.

concepts.title: Hardware-Accelerated Guardrails
concepts.summary: Accelerate selected safety and policy checks while keeping their detection limits, ordering, and failure behavior explicit.

concepts.title: Local Model Ingress/Egress
concepts.summary: Control how requests enter a locally hosted model and how data, tools, telemetry, and updates leave its environment.

concepts.title: Context Caching (Anthropic/OpenAI Feature)
concepts.summary: Reuse provider-supported computation for stable prompt prefixes while preserving fresh generation and provider-specific eligibility, retention, and billing rules.

concepts.title: Asynchronous Fine-Tuning Pipelines
concepts.summary: Run data preparation, adaptation, evaluation, and model promotion as a durable offline workflow with explicit quality gates and lineage.

concepts.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
concepts.summary: Standardize how agent hosts discover and invoke external capabilities while keeping trust, authorization, and business policy explicit.

concepts.title: Agent Evaluation & Regression Suites
concepts.summary: Evaluate complete agent behavior across task outcomes, tool effects, authorization, cost, and failure recovery before releasing changes.

concepts.title: Durable Workflow Execution
concepts.summary: Preserve business progress across process crashes, long waits, retries, and human approvals without duplicating external effects.

concepts.title: Agent Sandboxing & Capability Isolation
concepts.summary: Constrain agent-executed code and tools through independent process, filesystem, network, credential, and resource boundaries.

concepts.title: Agent Identity & Delegated Authorization
concepts.summary: Represent who requested an agent action, which workload performs it, and the exact authority delegated to each downstream operation.

concepts.title: Event Sourcing for Agent Workflows
concepts.summary: Represent business progress as an ordered history of accepted events so state, approvals, and effects can be reconstructed and audited.

concepts.title: Data Residency & Tenant Isolation
concepts.summary: Control where tenant information is processed and retained, and prevent cross-tenant access across every derived artifact and operational surface.

concepts.title: Multimodal Agent Pipelines
concepts.summary: Combine text, images, audio, video, and structured observations while preserving modality-specific evidence and uncertainty.

concepts.title: Agent Budgeting & Admission Control
concepts.summary: Reserve and enforce task-level limits for model tokens, tool calls, concurrency, elapsed time, and downstream load before work begins.

concepts.title: Memory Lifecycle & Forgetting
concepts.summary: Govern how agent memories are created, corrected, expired, and removed across source records, summaries, embeddings, caches, and backups.

concepts.title: Agent-to-Human Handoffs
concepts.summary: Transfer unresolved work with evidence, authority, ownership, and resumption conditions so a human can take effective control.

concepts.title: Agent Supply Chain Security
concepts.summary: Track and verify the origin, integrity, permissions, and release compatibility of models, prompts, tools, connectors, and agent dependencies.
